name: Hair Length Slider - (Krea2 + ZIT)
description: Warning about the Krea2 version. I just found out that it tends to make a lot of things longer, not just the hair. I will look into this in a v2. But until i make a v2 i have adjusted the recommended stable range to a range that should be ok. Outside of "Stable"-range use at your own risk XD Krea2: Stable from -2.5 to 2.5 (both Krea2 and ZIT) ZIT: Stable from -4 to 4 But works outside this range as well. Works very well in combination with my Hair Volume Slider All my work is 100% free. The only thing that really matters to me is people leaving a review , good or bad . I will NEVER remove or block anyone for leaving a bad review, so don't be afraid to give me criticism. I'm stating this because when a creator blocks someone for leaving a bad review, that person can no longer see any of the creator's models, essentially muting their critics. This is something I'm highly critical of, and I believe it's a fundamental quality problem on this site.
